page.layout: One block: a woodcut ornament at the top, then centred title lines in roman and italic capitals; a signature mark at the lower right. One printed page, no margins with text.
page.notes: A small handwritten or stamped mark ("L30" or similar) sits at the left beside the GVBERNATORIBVS line; it is not printed text and is omitted. Show-through and stains are ignored. The signature mark ")( 3" is transcribed as printed; "RE." is the start of the next word or running catchword-like fragment at the right.
